transcript: I have recently entered what I am calling my Immersive Theater Era™️ which is to say I am obsessed with immersive theater and I will see any and all immersive theater than I can. So when my friend JT said “Hey do you wanna go see Accomplice The Village?” I was like absolutely! Now I'm a little embarrassed to admit I had never heard of Accomplice but they have been running in New York for over 15 years! And they advertise themselves as New York’s longest running immersive experience which is really cool! And I think just calling it immersive theater does it a little bit of a disservice because it is part immersive theater but it's also part scavenger hunt part walking tour part escape room. Accomplice: The Village takes you all around the West Village where you will meet a variety of colorful characters each inspired by a character from the Wizard of Oz. Now you definitely don't need to have seen The Wizard of Oz or necessarily be a Wizard of Oz fan to enjoy this experience. But as someone who grew up on Wizard of Oz I really loved seeing all of the different references to the story as well as the way in which they would reimagine the characters to be residents of a modern New York City. I won't spoil anything about the actual story itself but I will say there is an overarching mystery: someone is missing, and you have to find them. And so each character you come across will give you new bits of information regarding that central mystery. And they will also give you a clue to your next destination which will either tell you where you need to go or what you need to do once you get there. The whole experience took just over 2 hours and if you are someone that is a fan of theater, and specifically immersive theater, or if you're a fan of escape rooms and puzzles then I definitely recommend checking this out!
